verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both share the same flaws. The plan cards are shrunk to tiny chips, and the MONTHLY/YEARLY/FAMILY labels and per-month text can't be read. The card order is scrambled to 6, 80, 48, which moves the featured yearly plan out of the middle. The two-line headline nearly touches the top and bottom of the canvas. The subhead and legal text are crammed into a small block against the right edge, and the fine print is close to the subhead's size. The pricing comparison, the core of the message, is effectively lost.
